header.name: Digital Spondylography
header.p: Vertebralogical System for Spinal Disorder Diagnosis

DICOM_upload_card.p_under_button: Upload files in DICOM format by clicking one of the buttons above.
DICOM_upload_card.p_under_button_accepted: All files uploaded. Clear or create a new session to upload new files.

main.p: Upload DICOM file to begin analyzing spinal disorders. This system provides automated detection and classification of vertebral compression fractures and other spinal abnormalities. It will also provide detailed diagnosis text.

privacy_note.title: Privacy Note
privacy_note.comment: All DICOM metadata remains confidential and secure.

editor.canvas_aria_label: {view} vertebra annotation canvas. Keyboard shortcuts: V select tool, H pan tool, A add vertebra, Escape cancel, Delete removes selection, Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z redo, Ctrl+A select all, Ctrl+0 zoom to fit.
editor.zoom_help: Zoom: {percentage}% | Drag or Mouse Wheel to pan/zoom
editor.autofill_confirm_overwrite: This view already has vertebra polygons. Autofill will replace them with AI-generated ones.

loading.error: Autofill failed. You can try again.

report.insufficient_annotation: Annotate at least one full anatomical region (cervical, thoracic, or lumbar) in the editor to generate a diagnosis for this projection.
report.disclaimer: This report is generated automatically from the annotated X-ray markup and is intended for educational and screening purposes only. All findings must be confirmed by a qualified radiologist or orthopedist. This tool does not replace professional medical diagnosis.
report.export_error: Could not generate the document. Please try again.

footer.p_up: Digital Spondylography project - Advanced Vertebralogical Platform
footer.p_down: For research and decision making purposes only. Not intended for primary diagnostic use.

no_file_loaded.p_up: No file was chosen for analysis
no_file_loaded.p_down: Upload files in DICOM format by clicking one of the buttons in top card.

segments.head: Part
segments.select_range_instructions: Drag the handles along the spine, or click a starting vertebra and Shift+click an ending vertebra to select a contiguous range.
segments.not_enough_vertebrae: Add at least 2 annotated vertebrae on this projection before creating a segment.
